'''Yyeger sugar''' was a type of [[Sugar/Legends|sugar]] that was in use by<ref name="MS:BS" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> The sugar could be finely spun and would normally melt on the [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]] of any individual who consumed it.<ref name="MS:BS" /> In 20 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the [[Doctor/Legends|surgeon]] [[Jos Vondar]] believed that the most finely spun yyeger sugar would not melt on the tongue of his colleague, [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]] [[Tolk le Trene]], after she pretended to not understand that he had romantic feelings for her.<ref name="MS:BS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yyeger sugar was mentioned in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', the first of two novels in the [[MedStar Duology]]. The novel was released in [[2004]] and written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="MS:BS" />
